events.name: Yorkshire by the Sea
events.description: Documentary following the lives of locals living along Yorkshire's coastline. This episode features members of the Robson family from Bridlington, who've been fishing the North Sea for generations, as they head up the coast to Whitby for a boat repair. Volunteers at Bempton Cliffs work to protect and preserve almost half a million seabirds, and a group of sea swimmers take a full-moon sea swim at Scarborough

The team work hard to create a beautiful garden for Jack, full of happy memories, art and a stunning new studio that he is able to access easily

event.name: The Holcroft Covenant
event.description: Spy thriller starring Michael Caine and Anthony Andrews. New York architect Noel Holcroft has had to live with the knowledge that his natural father, now dead, was a leading Nazi. One day he is summoned to Geneva and given a letter written by his father 40 years earlier. The contents of the letter, referring to his father's covenant, are to change his life.
